_.jxck.smx._: Jakub "Saint" Smx arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in P-F16 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Jakub "Saint" Smx wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Jakub "Saint" Smx watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Jakub "Saint" Smx was hit in the foot through his boot at P-F16. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Marek Thephatrat of the Hegemony (@thephatrat6060).
Jakub "Saint" Smx lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
Jakub "Saint" Smx did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Bastian Smx put a dented harmonica beside the bunk. Someone who had known Jakub "Saint" Smx helped clear the shelf without saying why.
A muddy dog crawled into P-F16 through the wire. Bastian Smx gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Lump.
Night raid. Bastian Smx crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Bastian Smx.
Bastian Smx spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Lump has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Bastian is very proud. Lump is mainly proud of the biscuits.
actioncam3000: At the depot, Gideon Actioncam had practised answering to his name. At R-F15, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
The First Wave ribbon marked Gideon Actioncam as an early volunteer. At R-F15, a newcomer asked what those first days had been like.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Gideon Actioncam's bunk. He has named it Bishop.
Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Gideon Actioncam helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Bishop the rat now waits for Gideon Actioncam at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.

Gideon Actioncam raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F15. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Wendel Green of the Hegemony (@femboy_green). Gideon Actioncam fired at a movement across the wire at R-F15. The man went down: Jakub Ebrrrvole, grazed.

The medics cleaned Gideon Actioncam's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F15. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Gideon Actioncam looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Bishop ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Gideon Actioncam followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Bishop his life.
Gideon Actioncam fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Wendel "Mole" Freddie, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

A bullet went through Gideon Actioncam's sleeve at R-F15 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Bastian Ebrrrvole of the Hegemony (@ebrrrvole). Gideon Actioncam borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Henrik Sedlomancz was grazed.
Gideon Actioncam walked back up the communication trench to R-F15, slower than before, but on his own feet.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Gideon Actioncam read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Gideon Actioncam has not seen Bishop for two days. He tells everyone rats come and go. He still leaves crumbs on the box. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Gideon Actioncam kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Frost made each footprint distinct. Gideon Actioncam followed a trail to the missing ration sack and found the quartermaster sitting on it.
Gideon Actioncam rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Silas Green was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Hugo Jameson stood up to sing louder, and Gideon Actioncam fired. Hugo Jameson was grazed. The singing stopped.
Gideon Actioncam measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
A recruit asked Gideon Actioncam how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
Gideon Actioncam reached up to fix a sandbag at R-F15 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Jonas Jacob of the Hegemony (@miguell.jacob).
Gideon no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
callmequeenorea_: Edmund Callmequeeno arrived at S-F16 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.

Edmund Callmequeeno and Arno Olie sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At relief, the next watch was told it had been a good hour. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Edmund Callmequeeno shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Edmund Callmequeeno agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
Edmund Callmequeeno and Bram Eccentricred split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd saw Edmund Callmequeeno freeze up on the fire step at Hill 304. Ghost said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Edmund Callmequeeno watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Edmund Callmequeeno had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Edmund Potato crossed it, Edmund Callmequeeno fired. Edmund Potato was badly wounded.
The artist tried again while Edmund Callmequeeno read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
A note came over the wire at Lantern Hill, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Quentin Lebronmygoat.' Edmund Callmequeeno sang louder.
Edmund Callmequeeno fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Tobias Hellcat, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Edmund Callmequeeno kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Edmund Callmequeeno sent the portrait home after asking the artist to leave the ears alone. A photograph would have cost more than he could spare. Edmund Callmequeeno got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 135. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Edmund Callmequeeno watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Edmund Callmequeeno could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water.
A reply from home thanked Edmund Callmequeeno for the portrait. It is already on the mantelpiece, where the family apparently recognises the ears.
A parcel from home held a comb. Edmund Callmequeeno has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
An empty jam tin became Edmund Callmequeeno's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F16. Edmund Callmequeeno was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Yann Duckman of the Hegemony (@duckman38259).
The House of Callmequeeno sent Clement Callmequeeno after Edmund Callmequeeno. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
A round went through the rim of Clement Callmequeeno's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Casimir "Button" Maupat of the Hegemony (@maupat_03).

A bullet went through Clement's upper arm at S-F16 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Roland "Lucky" Huncho of the Hegemony (@llsj_9huncho). The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the field hospital and called for Clement. He was asleep before they set him down.
carlos_lilsaint_: The quartermaster asked Jakub Lilsaint to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Florian "Button" Thebaileebla taught Jakub Lilsaint to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
Jakub Lilsaint and Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

A bullet clipped Jakub Lilsaint's helmet at S-F17 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Marek "Brick" Buddy of the Concord (@big_fat_buddy). The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Jakub Lilsaint did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
The medics cleaned Jakub Lilsaint's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F17.
Dawn watch. Jakub Lilsaint put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Albin Warhamster, grazed.
Jakub Lilsaint of the Hegemony spotted Otto Commanderchr of the Concord repairing a parapet at the Drowned Farm. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Jakub Lilsaint. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.

At S-F17 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Jakub Lilsaint turned around and took a shovel blow. Albin Warhamster of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Albin Warhamster of the Concord (@warhamster4). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Jakub Lilsaint watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Jakub Lilsaint. He died on the stretcher before morning.

Another member of the House of Lilsaint reached the line: Casimir Lilsaint. He asked where Jakub Lilsaint had slept, then chose a different corner. Casimir Lilsaint got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 203. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Casimir Lilsaint folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Valentin Coleharrison, grazed. Casimir Lilsaint cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
A single shot from across the wire hit Casimir Lilsaint in the thigh at S-F17. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Arno "Crow" Hakkinen of the Concord (@henri.hakkinen.566).
No bed for Casimir Lilsaint yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Casimir Lilsaint survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at S-F17, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
A bullet hit Casimir Lilsaint's belt buckle at S-F17 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Arno Ricks of the Concord (@sam.ricks).
Casimir Lilsaint was put on light duty at S-F17: peeling potatoes, sorting mail, and complaining.
Three days with a bandage, and Casimir is back at S-F17. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
cermitboy: Tobias Cermitboy came up the line with a lucky button and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Tobias Cermitboy saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike, grazed. The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Tobias Cermitboy was faster. Zeno Beaucookie was grazed. A letter from home reached Tobias Cermitboy before dusk. Tobias Cermitboy read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Tobias Cermitboy helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Tobias Cermitboy fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch was grazed. The water jacket hissed as Tobias Cermitboy fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut was grazed.
Tobias Cermitboy thought about an old father who runs the family shop alone on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.

Tobias Cermitboy found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a wedding party, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire. A letter from home reached Tobias Cermitboy before dusk. Tobias Cermitboy read it twice and slept a little easier.

Thunder shook dust from the beams over Tobias Cermitboy. For once, nobody blamed the enemy. A letter from home reached Tobias Cermitboy before dusk. Tobias Cermitboy read it twice and slept a little easier.

Tobias Cermitboy joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Tobias Cermitboy across the shin at T-F17. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Oskar Otakujake of the Concord (@otakujake_). Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Tobias Cermitboy anyway.

Tobias Cermitboy was hit in the hip at T-F17. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Albin "Mole" Bricky of the Concord (@bricky_ua). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Tobias Cermitboy fell at T-F17 and never moved again. Shot by Albin "Mole" Bricky of the Concord (@bricky_ua).
Bram Cermitboy arrived carrying the family name of Tobias Cermitboy. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
A clear shot from T-F17. Bram grazed Pavel Thesenorfry and slid back down below the parapet.
csllgaks: On the way to S-F8, Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Stand-to at dawn. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Nils Wolfmananton, grazed.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

A bullet found Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks at S-F8, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Walter Ice of the Hegemony (@iron__from__ice_). Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Roland Monster crossed it, Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks fired. Roland Monster was grazed.
Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.

Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F8 and grazed Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Walter Ice of the Hegemony (@iron__from__ice_).

Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-F8, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Rafael "Bones" Gaita of the Hegemony (@gaita_4119).
A medic brought Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.

A medic stopped by Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks had gone back to S-F8. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks's ear at S-F8 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon of the Hegemony (@mateorekon). Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Zeno Retarded was grazed. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 119. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F8 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Walter Ice of the Hegemony (@iron__from__ice_).
Three days with a bandage, and Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks is back at S-F8. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks swept the enemy parapet at S-F8 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Dorian Mateorekon was badly wounded.
Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F8, then nothing but pain. Raider: Matthias Mihai of the Hegemony (@angel._.mihai).

Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks was hit in the hip at S-F8. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Bram Roma of the Hegemony (@vitto_roma07). Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks was hit at S-F8 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Bram Roma of the Hegemony (@vitto_roma07).
The papers say Clement Csllgaks. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks's eyes. Nobody in S-F8 argues.
The sergeant at S-F8 called out a range and a spot. Clement was the only one who hit it. Dorian "Saint" Dallas was badly wounded.
dalev44: Otto Dalev introduced himself as a choir singer from Varenne. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Otto Dalev helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Otto Dalev made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. The clerk counted the names twice. Otto Dalev is number 625 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Otto Dalev folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Matthias "Hollow" Dvic, badly wounded. Otto Dalev cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Otto Dalev fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-S17. Viktor Triskit was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Otto Dalev tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Otto Dalev hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Otto Dalev was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-S17. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Marek Triskit of the Concord (@triskit166).
Back on the fire step at S-S17. Otto Dalev says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Otto Dalev sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.

A bullet found Otto at S-S17, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Gustav Burgosgeovan of the Concord (@burgosgeovanni). Otto was shot dead at S-S17 while looking over the parapet. The squad did not move for an hour.
The House of Dalev sent another. Felix "Parson" Dalev, uncle of Otto Dalev, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
daxmunro: In Coldwater, Viktor "Rabbit" Daxmunro was a coal miner. In R-R17, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a coal miner again.

Viktor "Rabbit" Daxmunro felt a hard tug at his hip at R-R17. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Gustav Mondo of the Hegemony (@il_migliore_al_mondo). After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Viktor "Rabbit" Daxmunro helped stack spare sandbags at R-R17. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A round came through the loophole Viktor "Rabbit" Daxmunro was watching at R-R17 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Jonas Hill of the Hegemony (@_strawberry.hill_). Viktor "Rabbit" Daxmunro looked over the parapet at R-R17 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Jonas Hill of the Hegemony (@_strawberry.hill_).

Ulrich Daxmunro took the same post at R-R17 where Viktor "Rabbit" Daxmunro stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. Grey Mill is lost. Ulrich Daxmunro heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Ulrich Daxmunro hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Ulrich Daxmunro borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
Ulrich Daxmunro sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
Ulrich Daxmunro of the Concord lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at Grey Mill. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Marek Azstarlord's name scratched on the lid.

A bullet went into Ulrich Daxmunro's chest just under the heart at R-R17. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Jonas Hill of the Hegemony (@_strawberry.hill_). Ulrich Daxmunro was killed outright at R-R17, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Jonas Hill of the Hegemony (@_strawberry.hill_).
Albin "Crow" Daxmunro had heard about Ulrich Daxmunro's courage. At R-R17, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Albin "Crow" Daxmunro (Concord) and Rafael Forgacserik (Hegemony) came to the same broken well at Lantern Hill at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.
Albin rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Gustav Mondo was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
forgettable_collins: In Greyhallow, Pavel "Parson" Collins was a choir singer. In Q-F21, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a choir singer again.

Pavel "Parson" Collins was on watch at Q-F21 when the night raid hit. The men found Pavel "Parson" Collins at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Zeno Helldiver of the Hegemony (@some_random_helldiver).
Otto Collins came to the front because his brother Pavel "Parson" Collins never came home. He carries his mother's thimble.

A recruit asked Otto Collins how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-F21 with the rations. Otto Collins ate while listening to the revised orders.
Otto Collins tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Greyhallow. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
Otto Collins and the recruit have reached whole words. Lessons take place beside the stove, with spelling corrections from people pretending not to listen.
The east wind brought the smell of the other trenches: smoke, lime and somebody's cooking. Otto Collins was hungry and furious about it.
The recruit wrote a first short letter without Otto Collins's help. He was allowed to check the envelope, but not the contents.

Otto Collins was on the dawn watch at Q-F21 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Otto Collins was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Zeno Helldiver of the Hegemony (@some_random_helldiver).
Otto Collins no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
A reply arrived for the recruit. Otto listened while it was read aloud, slowly, without once supplying a word.
jennyschrader: After 4 days of war, S-S10 had a place for everything. On Day 5, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade.

The guns found S-S10. Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade was dug out of a collapsed dugout with both legs pinned and carried back on a groundsheet. Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
The beds were full. Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade waits on a stretcher in the dark with a medic's promise and a dry mouth.
The medics would not give up on Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-S10 today.
Shellfire stopped the carrying party at a trench junction. Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade waited under a load that got heavier by the minute.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. The clerk counted the names twice. Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade is number 365 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-S10 and grazed Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Jakub Fts of the Concord (@souza.fts.085).
Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade won before reaching the end of his entry.
Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade was hit in the hip at S-S10. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Lucien Coreyjmcmich of the Concord (@coreyjmcmichael).
Karel spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to S-S10.
julio.menezes921: Pavel Menezes introduced himself as a shepherd from Port Abel. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
As one of the first hundred volunteers, Pavel Menezes received the First Wave ribbon. A neighbour lent the needle and supervised every stitch.
Pavel Menezes asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a signaller. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
Pavel Menezes traded a book with the last pages torn out for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.

Listening post, three in the morning. Pavel Menezes heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards. The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into S-F13. Pavel Menezes has learned to walk bent double.
Pavel Menezes lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
The barrage caught Pavel Menezes in the open at S-F13. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. Pavel Menezes died at his post at S-F13 when the dugout roof came down under a direct hit.

The papers say Felix "Bones" Menezes. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Pavel Menezes's eyes. Nobody in S-F13 argues. The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Felix "Bones" Menezes was number 47. He still remembers how stiff the colonel's glove felt.

The salvo walked along S-F13 and caught Felix "Bones" Menezes in the open. Two men carried him back between salvos. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Felix "Bones" Menezes shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Felix "Bones" Menezes died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.

Silas Menezes put a book with the last pages torn out beside the bunk. Someone who had known Felix "Bones" Menezes helped clear the shelf without saying why. Silas Menezes was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F13 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
Silas Menezes fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Tobias "Crow" Cowboii, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Silas Menezes had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Benedikt Jakubwilkuu crossed it, Silas Menezes fired. Benedikt Jakubwilkuu was badly wounded.
Silas Menezes borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii was grazed.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Silas Menezes was hit hard in the fight at S-F13 before anyone could fire. The raider was Marek Jackmdunn of the Concord. Raider: Marek Jackmdunn of the Concord (@jackmdunn06). Silas Menezes walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Silas Menezes walked back up the communication trench to S-F13, slower than before, but on his own feet. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Silas Menezes could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Across from S-F13, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Silas Menezes saw it. Ulrich Emmettofthek was badly wounded.
Silas Menezes of the Hegemony and Arno Coopergfulto of the Concord share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at the Chalk Pits now wait for it before they sleep.
The parcel for Silas Menezes contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Shrapnel at Saint-Ash crossroads. Silas Menezes walked to the medics on his own feet and asked for a cigarette before the stitches.
Silas Menezes no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
At S-F13 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Silas Menezes won the bet. Bastian Ronne was badly wounded.
Silas woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained.
kubawoj0911: In Tannenfeld, Zeno Kubawoj was a fisherman. In U-F19, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a fisherman again. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Zeno Kubawoj watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
New laces made Zeno Kubawoj's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Kubawoj. Zeno Kubawoj read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Zeno Kubawoj was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at U-F19. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Tobias "Whistle" Train of the Concord (@goober_train).
No bed for Zeno Kubawoj yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Zeno Kubawoj returned to U-F19 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at U-F19. Zeno Kubawoj was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Konrad Tripletonyt of the Concord (@tripletonyt).
Bastian Kubawoj came to the front because his uncle Zeno Kubawoj never came home. He carries a lock of hair in a matchbox.
Bastian Kubawoj measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong.
Bastian checked the wire at U-F19 on his hands and knees. It was whole. He returned before dawn with mud on his chin.
maksim_matroska_42: On Day 9 Bram "Crow" Matroska took a post at R-C13 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He is superstitious about the number three, and the men liked him for it.

Bram "Crow" Matroska counted the steps of the Hegemony sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Wendel Green never saw the shovel coming. (@femboy_green) The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Bram "Crow" Matroska watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram "Crow" Matroska. Bram "Crow" Matroska read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Bram "Crow" Matroska could not stop listening to it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram "Crow" Matroska. Bram "Crow" Matroska read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Bram "Crow" Matroska got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 683. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-C13, Bram "Crow" Matroska listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Bram "Crow" Matroska said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Bram "Crow" Matroska borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.

Wiring party. Bram "Crow" Matroska held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at R-C13, and everyone came back. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram "Crow" Matroska. Bram "Crow" Matroska read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Bram "Crow" Matroska owes Dietrich Ghosteye so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram "Crow" Matroska. Bram "Crow" Matroska read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The Hegemony sentry, Quentin Allistofeari, shouted once. Bram "Crow" Matroska silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@allistofearisgod) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Bram "Crow" Matroska snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Bram "Crow" Matroska free.
Bram "Crow" Matroska rejoined the squad at R-C13. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.

Bram cut Silas "Tin" Roman's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. There was a parcel for Bram: socks, a cake, and a note that said eat the cake first. Bram ate the cake first.
nestorickdave: At the depot, Felix Nestorickdav had practised answering to his name. At N-F16, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Felix Nestorickdav of the Hegemony and Nils Scotti of the Concord have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at the Ossuary Wood. It is getting crowded.

A bullet hit Felix Nestorickdav in the neck at N-F16. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen of the Concord (@moonroleen). The bearers reached Felix Nestorickdav at N-F16 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen of the Concord (@moonroleen).
Leopold Nestorickdav asked about Felix Nestorickdav on arriving at N-F16. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

Fresh from training, Leopold Nestorickdav still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Gustav "Crow" Youngmoneyja, badly wounded. Leopold Nestorickdav read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.
Leopold and Silas Raulrdrgzz stood watch together and traded jokes in whispers. The jokes were old, but the whispers were new.
slush2083: Norbert "Shadow" Slush arrived at R-R12 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Norbert "Shadow" Slush fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-R12. Felix "Mole" Ngles was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. The men at R-R12 heard Norbert "Shadow" Slush call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Arno "Parson" Theverb of the Concord (@theverb95). Norbert "Shadow" Slush was killed at R-R12 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Arno "Parson" Theverb of the Concord (@theverb95).
The House of Slush sent another. Matthias "Shadow" Slush, brother of Norbert "Shadow" Slush, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Matthias "Shadow" Slush went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Matthias "Shadow" Slush watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Matthias "Shadow" Slush and Silas Haydengonzal carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Matthias "Shadow" Slush found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Teodor Casualkriegs gave Matthias "Shadow" Slush the last match in the trench. Shadow used it to light a candle so that Teodor could finish a letter.
A bullet hit Matthias "Shadow" Slush's belt buckle at R-R12 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Walter "Button" Jmw of the Concord (@jmw094).

Machine-gun fire swept R-R12. Matthias "Shadow" Slush took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Dorian "Owl" Coreyxpainte of the Concord (@coreyxpainter). The bearers reached Matthias "Shadow" Slush at R-R12 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Dorian "Owl" Coreyxpainte of the Concord (@coreyxpainter).
The papers say Jakub Slush. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Matthias "Shadow" Slush's eyes. Nobody in R-R12 argues.

Jakub Slush felt a hard tug at his hip at R-R12. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Matthias Earley of the Concord (@justin.earley.73).
Jakub rejoined the squad at R-R12. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
steviepac: Day 14: Lucien "Owl" Steviepac reached M-F12 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy. Lucien "Owl" Steviepac's transfer to the role of field cook was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Lucien "Owl" Steviepac and Karel Ferris sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. A letter from home found Lucien "Owl" Steviepac before the night shift. Lucien "Owl" Steviepac folded it small and kept it close.

The men have learned that Lucien "Owl" Steviepac keeps feeding the rats. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal. Lucien "Owl" Steviepac kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.
Lucien "Owl" Steviepac washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
The queue for soup was long. Lucien gave the last man a double portion without being asked. A letter came for Lucien with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Lucien pinned it to the dugout wall.
thatguy8954: Albin "Tin" Thatguy came up on Day 9 carrying news from Greyhallow. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Albin "Tin" Thatguy did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Albin "Tin" Thatguy asked if second helpings depended on the answer. Victory at Grey Mill. Albin "Tin" Thatguy let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Albin "Tin" Thatguy tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper.

Albin "Tin" Thatguy borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. The transfer made Albin "Tin" Thatguy a sapper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Albin "Tin" Thatguy was hit in the forearm at S-R5. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin "Tin" Thatguy. Albin "Tin" Thatguy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Albin "Tin" Thatguy rejoined the squad at S-R5. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.

Albin "Tin" Thatguy went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Concord trench a man turned around too late. Walter "Tin" Hansaazz did not get up again. (@hansaazz) A letter reached Albin "Tin" Thatguy with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Albin "Tin" Thatguy tried to as well.
Albin "Tin" Thatguy set a charge under the enemy listening post. Then he waited all night for an order that did not come.
Albin sharpened a shovel until it could shave. He did not shave with it, but the squad respected the shovel.
